Dr Amara Ndlovu

Dr Amara Ndlovu is Associate Professor in the Department of Information Systems at Southern Cape Institute of Technology.

Dr Amara Ndlovu's stated research interests are enterprise architecture, responsible AI governance, and resilient digital transformation.

Dr Amara Ndlovu's 2025 publication, "Architecture Controls for Responsible AI Adoption", examines governance mechanisms in complex organisations.

Dr Amara Ndlovu is currently accepting doctoral Candidates for projects beginning in 2027.
